tools.name: blackboard_change
tools.description: Apply one atomic semantic-change-batch/v2 to the bound Project. It cannot create Evidence; use blackboard_retain_evidence. Change lifecycle state with transition. A new Attempt created by the Runtime must include its tests relation in the same batch. Reuse the same idempotency key after an uncertain retry.

tools.name: blackboard_record_attempt_result
tools.description: Record one complete Attempt result atomically. Supply exactly one Attempt identity mode: create=true or expected_version. A succeeded result requires at least one produced target.

tools.name: blackboard_read
tools.description: Read the current complete semantic record and its current relationships by Blackboard Key.

tools.name: blackboard_history
tools.description: Read explicit cursor-paginated Semantic History by Blackboard Key; default limit 20 and maximum 100.

tools.name: blackboard_retain_evidence
tools.description: Use this tool as the only way to create or replace one confined Evidence payload produced by an open Attempt. The server derives managed integrity fields.

tools.name: blackboard_checkpoint_attempt
tools.description: Version the compact summary of an owned open Attempt and participate in pending Blackboard synchronization.

tools.name: blackboard_finish
tools.description: Finish the bound Continuation after all of its Attempts are terminal; accepts no Task Summary or outcome copy.
